evidence.oralText: 天塌了，昨晚给T3布置上任务就去睡了，早晨一看devin套餐已经被用了9%，但是我只给T3用swe2，也就是说，如果还有额度，swe2也会吃额度，只有用完了额度，再用swe2才是免费！
evidence.quotaPercent: Official weekly included usage 9% used, resets in 6 days.
evidence.conflictsToKeep: The claim that SWE-2 consumes included quota until the included pool is exhausted, and is free only afterwards, is the author's inference from 'I only assigned SWE-2' plus a 9% bar. We cannot verify the overnight task mix from the screenshot. This may qualify the already-staged 'Devin SWE-2 permanently free' root, but it is not an official policy statement. Do not stitch with platatofore's Pro 74%/1.8B oral.
evidence.recommendation: 讨论作为已登记「SWE-2 永久免费」的可能限定条件，须官方或维护者确认；不要自动改 adopted
evidence.why: 官方周条只有 9% used，无 token、档位未标明；SWE-2 仍吃剩余订阅额度是作者推断，不是官方政策原文。
